desc:
ECONOMY UPDATE OUT NOW! See what's new here: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/economy-update-change-log-rise-to-presidency/4815320

This game is in alpha.

❗❗ Join our community server 👾 to find or advertise political parties!

🔄 Recent Updates 🔄
• Economy update! Taxes, salary controls, government budget, Secretary of the Treasury, new power generators to loot from, + more!

🏛️ Start your own political party and run for President! Build up your government and run the police department, military, prison, hospital and more! Create a city full of chaos, or try to build a peaceful civilisation.

🔫 Don't like your current government? Assassinate the President to remove them from office and call an emergency election!

💥 Start a RIOT to reveal the President's location to all players!

👮 Play as police, military, paramedic, fire service, a criminal and more. Fight fires, or burn down player houses and cars! 🔥

💸 Rob the bank, or rob other players!

Credits can be found in-game.
